steps: At execution start, update progress.md within 600 words with the verified three-contract state, saved history-family reports, this narrower scope and the execution deadline. Preserve the history-family result in a versioned architecture-local note before changing the current result summary. Record the skeptical audit and reserve at least the final 120 seconds for checks and response. Do not reopen completed history drafting or perform another broad audit.

Create docs/design/proposal/architecture/uncertainty-admission-contract-v1.md and uncertainty-admission-fixtures-v1.json. Define a shared record header: immutable identity/version, category, full context, evidence/review/time view, family/branch scope, provenance, dependencies, proposed operation and requested admission layer. Define outputs containing disposition, admitted predicate or selected assumption, support references, unresolved obligations, affected dependencies and next permissible operation. Separate retained assertions from constraints admitted into a family.

Specify category-dependent rules for extraction readings, historical facts, accounting elections, measurement estimates, behavior policies and future innovations. Address semantic interpretation explicitly rather than hiding it inside extraction. Distinguish review of a reading from factual truth; finite or continuous factual domains from elections; dated permission and eligibility from unsupported treatments; estimates from observed amounts; policy information from future realizations; and unweighted future possibilities from probabilistic models. Unsupported operations preserve the proposed content and reason without silently admitting it.

Specify operation preconditions and postconditions for new evidence, narrowing under unchanged assumptions, correction/supersession, explicit assumption selection, election selection, estimate revision and policy/driver revision. Narrowing intersects the existing supported domain; correction creates a new version and need not narrow it. An empty intersection identifies a scoped conflict, not automatic global impossibility. Preserve frozen views and propagate invalidation through changed dependencies and candidate membership. Reject category substitution, dangling references and unsupported dependency cycles without claiming that mutually constrained economic quantities must be independent.

Define interactions with existing evidence/time/history contracts and named responsibilities for accounting, persistence, language/IR and failure semantics. Keep admission status, source truth, accounting validity, capability support and computation status distinct. Probability-model attachment and likelihood updates must explicitly require the later joint-measure contract; this slice provides no uniform weights, independence assumptions or normalization over successful branches. State information-cutoff requirements without attempting complete scenario-mode or causal-intervention semantics.

Save eight focused fixture groups as their sections are completed: competing extraction/interpretation readings; a continuous factual interval narrowed by evidence; a synthetically permitted election versus missing authority; an estimate revised with dated inputs; a behavior choice denied future-realized information; an unweighted future domain with no probability claim; linked revisions with transitive invalidation and frozen access; and invalid category substitution or dependency references. Each group must give explicit inputs, expected outputs/reasons, preserved records and affected family constraints. Include admissible, evidence-refuted and unsupported outcomes. Use a small interval example such as [0,100] intersected with [20,60], plus a conflicting interval, to make expected set operations independently checkable.

Compare two credible encodings on those same fixtures: tagged variant payloads with a shared header, and generic records with a versioned category-validator registry. Explain validation, extension and migration tradeoffs; propose one provisionally without selecting a runtime library. Record provenance, justification, failure mode, smallest diagnostic and proposal/convenience status for each material choice. Explicitly reject adopting P06 finite-only facts, mandatory weighted innovations, hold-only behavior or restricted estimate formulas as universal requirements.

Add hashed references and a clearly partial uncertainty-admission work record to architecture.json. Keep uncertainty in unfinished_contracts and keep the three complete proposed contract rows intact; do not add a placeholder uncertainty row. Preserve all fourteen decisions, profile alternatives and wider mission obligations. Update result.md and progress.md with actual saved scope, every changed file, pending review and the exact next joint-measure task. No code, tests, checker, controller, catalog or frozen evidence changes are permitted.

Run bounded standard-library checks for JSON validity, required local fields, unique fixture IDs, reference/hash integrity, category coverage, interval arithmetic, transition outcomes and dependency invalidation. Cross-check prose and fixtures manually because field checks cannot establish semantics. Save a fresh nonempty uncertainty-admission-consistency-check-v1.json. Run PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 scripts/check_accounting_proposal.py --phase P16 --check once, capturing stdout in a new uncertainty-admission-structural-check-v1.json and recording exit status separately. Confirm any failure is the expected incomplete inventory; investigate new failures without editing the checker.

Stop when the admission specification, eight fixture groups, matched alternatives, partial architecture references, result/checkpoint and actual diagnostic reports are saved. Return PARTIAL for P16 with any unfinished subsection named precisely. Do not expand into probability derivations, authority acquisition, lifecycle implementation or profile selection. If time reaches the reserved interval first, save completed sections and identify the smallest remaining repair.
